#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# env_setup.sh
# Project environment bootstrap (customize as needed)

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT_DIR"

echo "[env_setup] Root: $ROOT_DIR"

# Example: create a local .env if missing
if [[ ! -f .env ]]; then
  cat > .env <<'EOF'
# Add your environment variables here
# EXAMPLE_VAR=example
EOF
  echo "[env_setup] Created .env"
else
  echo "[env_setup] .env already exists"
fi

# Example: install Node dependencies if package.json exists
if [[ -f package.json ]]; then
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[env_setup] Installing npm dependencies..."
    npm install
  else
    echo "[env_setup] npm not found; skipping npm install" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "[env_setup] Done."
